say.9.2061: nine point two oh six one
say.148341: one four eight, three four one

scenes.name: NINETEEN POINTS
lines: Nineteen integer points lie on the sphere x squared plus y squared plus z squared equals 867.
球面 x² + y² + z² = 867 上恰有十九个整点。
Join them by 135 edges, each with a charge-dependent phase.
用 135 条边把它们连起来，每条边带一个随荷而变的相位。
Five hypercharges, five spectra: in every one, three modes sit low.
五种超荷，五套谱：每一套里都有三个模落在低端。
Are three low notes three generations of matter?
三声低音，就是三代物质吗？

scenes.name: ONE GAP, WHOLE TORUS
lines: Here are all nineteen eigenvalues per charge. Now turn the two clocks across the whole torus.
这是每种荷的全部十九个本征值。现在转动两只钟，扫过整张环面。
Three cyan modes stay below 8.685; sixteen stay above 9.6.
三个青色模始终低于 8.685，十六个始终高于 9.6。
An interval certificate extends this to the whole torus and every positive zero.
区间证书把这一点推广到整张环面与全部正零点。

scenes.name: TURN THE COORDINATES
lines: Why one of each? Cycle the coordinates, x to y, y to z, z to x.
为什么三个轻模各不相同？把坐标轮换：x 变 y，y 变 z，z 变 x。
The shell lands on itself, so each matrix splits into blocks of seven, six and six.
球壳映回自身，于是每个矩阵都拆成七、六、六三块。
Each block holds exactly one light mode: characters one, omega, omega squared.
每块恰有一个轻模：特征标 1、ω、ω² 各占一个。
Lean checks the backbone: even Chebyshev characters are orthonormal under a pi-free Haar average.
Lean 内核检验其有理骨架：无 π 哈尔平均下，偶次切比雪夫特征标正交归一。

scenes.name: WHERE TO CUT
lines: But three is not forced: shared gaps allow one, three, seven or fifteen.
但三并非必然：共享谱隙容许 1、3、7 或 15 个轻模。
The widest gap picks one; equal characters leave three and fifteen.
最宽谱隙选出 1；特征标等重则留下 3 与 15。
One cut reads only edge weights: T equals nine plus one minus delta, squared.
有一种分界只读边权：T = 9 + (1 − δ)²。
Three outer sites of degree ten attain it, so T sits just below ten.
三个度为 10 的外点取到它，所以 T 略小于 10。

scenes.name: THREE ZEROS
lines: Read the two-step masses at actual zeros, against the cut nine and the cut T.
在实际零点上读两步质量，对照分界 9 与分界 T。
At zero 8236 the third mass is 9.2061: above nine, below T.
第 8236 号零点的第三个质量是 9.2061：高于 9，低于 T。
Under T it is the earliest zero to hit all three windows; T also rescues zero 148341.
按 T 分界，它是最早三窗齐中的零点；T 还挽救了第 148341 号零点。
Still, T is a model choice: with charge-conjugate pairs per site, zero 8359 keeps two charge-two modes.
但 T 仍是模型假设：换成共轭双态站点，第 8359 号零点的荷二只剩两模。

scenes.name: INTO FOUR DIMENSIONS
lines: Three eigenvalues are not yet four-dimensional Weyl fermions.
三个本征值，还不是四维外尔费米子。
A five-step overlap kernel, with Wilson mass in a narrow window, gives three species of one chirality.
威尔逊质量落在窄窗内时，五步重叠核给出三个同手征物种。
With the shell as mass, the index is three times a single one; sixteen heavy layers give zero.
以球壳作质量项，指数恰为单份的三倍；十六个重层为零。

scenes.name: ROUGH FIELDS
lines: But rough gauge links dominate the path integral.
可路径积分的主体，是粗糙的规范链。
One SU five background gives indices two and seven: centre charge twelve, two mod five.
一个 SU(5) 粗糙背景给出指数 (2, 7)：中心荷 12，模 5 余 2。
Three Higgs frames lose the gap; four frames hold it.
三份希格斯标架守不住谱隙，四份才守得住。
Still open: why three, not fifteen; why this cut; and a chiral measure with no frames put in by hand.
仍然开放：为何是 3 不是 15，为何是这条分界，以及无外置标架的手征测度。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter seven.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第七章
